title: Duplicate Records Detection
description: Identification of redundant observational records across primary keys, composite keys, or complete feature rows.
conditions: Multi-source data integration or batch ingestion pipeline executed
Suspected replay of transactional events or survey resubmissions
High frequency of identical feature vectors in tabular data
recommended_methods: Exact row hashing via SHA-256 for identical duplicate discovery
Composite key uniqueness checking across business keys (e.g., patient_id + visit_date)
Jaro-Winkler or Levenshtein distance matching for fuzzy duplicate detection
selection_rules: If primary key is duplicate but timestamps differ, apply latest-record survivorship rule
If exact duplicates across all columns exist, retain single representative instance and drop remainder
If partial duplicate matches on entity identifiers, flag for human reconciliation or automated merge
limitations: Fuzzy duplicate algorithms scale quadratically O(N^2) without blocking or indexing
Legitimate recurring events (e.g. repeated daily lab tests) can be misidentified as duplicates
